alice (eng-platform): heads-up: product wants a new console dashboard for Private deployments. need a small cross-team sync about what the onprem agent can ship over the wire (metrics + audit hooks) and what runtime needs for routing/quotas.

ben (eng-runtime): quick Q — is this for pull (agent scrapes) or push (agent sends)? affects handshake and firewall rules.

alice (eng-platform): prefer push over TLS so we don't rely on customer's prometheus. agent will batch and POST to our ingest endpoint.

carmen (eng-infra): push is fine but customers will lock egress. we need a minimal port list and a proxy fallback. most customers only allow 443 outbound. also need mutual TLS or sig-based auth.

ben (eng-runtime): ok. runtime needs these fields per telemetry message: deployment_id, customer_id, model_name, model_variant, runtime_version, seq_len, tokens_generated, latency_p50/p95, kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_size, error_code (if any), billing_units. can we standardize naming?

dan (product): dashboard should show: requests/s, avg latency, p95, tokens/s, cost/unit over time, top failing routes, and a per-deployment SLA tile. want to support drilldown to raw audit log for a request id.

alice (eng-platform): audit logs: we need an append-only hook that attaches an encrypted per-request record for any failed request (>=5xx) and for rollouts flagged by QA. must not contain customer PII. Carmen — can KMS envelope encryption in transit work for customers?

carmen (eng-infra): we can support envelope encryption where customer KMS (customer-managed key) is used to wrap dataset keys. agent will encrypt payload locally then send. we'll need a KMS endpoint + key-id in handshake. also have to ensure HSM policies aren't violated.

ben (eng-runtime): handshake proposal: agent POST /handshake -> returns ingest_url, cert_fingerprint (our root), allowed_payload_schema_version, max_batch_bytes, signing_challenge. Agent then establishes mTLS or signs each payload with the challenge response.

ops-bot: deploy:telemetry-ingest v2 started on infra-telemetry at 1748000550 :rocket:

alice (eng-platform): sample payload (very small):
```json
{
  "deployment_id":"dep-1234",
  "customer_id":"cust-7",
  "model":"gptx-8b-q4",
  "runtime_version":"r1.4.2",
  "tokens_generated":120,
  "latency_ms":230,
  "kv_cache_hit_rate":0.82,
  "billing_units":0.0034,
  "sample_request_id":"req-20220707-abc"
}
```

carmen (eng-infra): firewall rule suggestion for customers: allow outbound to telemetry.redwood-inference.com:443 (TLS). if customer requires IPs, give them this CIDR list (will publish in onboarding doc). customers that disallow direct egress can configure an HTTP CONNECT proxy; agent supports CONNECT + client cert auth.

ben (eng-runtime): internal API change: expose per-deployment quota counters in the runtime (tokens_consumed, requests_consumed) and emit them to telemetry with a tag "quota_config_version". we need a small API change in runtime SDK, will open PR.

alice (eng-platform): UI: create a new "Private deployments" dashboard template with configurable SLO lines, and a toggle to view "redacted audit logs" which shows only request id, timestamp, error class. full audit retrieval will be admin-only with additional KMS unwrapping flow.

dan (product): UX note: for rollouts we want a canary lane: show metrics for canary vs baseline side-by-side. plus an alert when p95 increases >20% AND kv_cache_hit_rate drops >10% for 5m.

ben (eng-runtime): action items from runtime: 1) add quota counters + schema (PR by EOD Friday), 2) implement handshake client in agent SDK (draft Monday).

carmen (eng-infra): action items infra: 1) document IP/CIDR and proxy flow, 2) prod ingress cert rotation plan with customer KMS wrap.

alice (eng-platform): action items product/platform: 1) dashboard wireframe (I'll drop a figma link), 2) onboarding checklist update (firewall + KMS steps).

ops-bot: reminder: telemetry-ingest team retro tomorrow 10:30am PT.

ben (eng-runtime): thumbs up. I'll start the PR and tag you all.

alice (eng-platform): thanks — will follow up with a short spreadsheet mapping metric -> alert/breakdown for dashboard build. :thumbsup:
